Laura Pausini - Yo Canto 2 (Deluxe) [2026]
Latin Pop / Ballad / Acoustic | Qobuz FLAC 16-Bit/44.1 kHz | 1h 16m
The unmistakable voice of Italy pays a new tribute to Spanish-language music.
Twenty years after the historic success of her first cover album, Laura Pausini returns with "Yo Canto 2", an intimate and spectacular journey through the songs that marked the history of Hispanic and Ibero-American music.
With her unparalleled vocal power and new arrangements, Laura reinterprets immortal classics like "Hijo de la Luna", "Mariposa Tecknicolor", "Bachata Rosa", and "Hasta la Raíz". This 21-track Deluxe edition includes stellar collaborations with artists such as Ricardo Montaner, Nahuel Pennisi, and Mikel Izal, delivering a work full of nostalgia, respect, and pure romance.
